title: Saints Will Not Save the Morally Bankrupt!
body:
The saints of Egypt, al-Awtaad. Is it not like this? There are saints there but they never stand up to support
that nation. If the people’s actions were purely for Allah (swt), in one hour all (their troubles) would end. But
the objective of the Egyptian nation is this world: they want this world, they are not asking for the Hereafter,
or asking for Allah (swt). No! Therefore, let them eat one another! Otherwise, it would be easy for awliyaullah
to make everything stop, but they are not interfering nor even supporting the Egyptian people. And that is
because they are asking for this world, to be leaders and to satisfy all their egoistic desires.
This is their objective; the mosques are empty! I heard there are twenty-million people in Cairo, and how
many mosques, a thousand? Even if there are a thousand mosques, that is not enough. In every alley there
are coffee shops and entertainment parks that distract them from worshipping their Lord. People there run
after dunya to satisfy their egoistic desires. They do not worry about mosques, prayers or dhikr. How many
centers are there to entertain twenty million people? There must be at least 100,000 entertainment places,
where people gather and get drunk. They eat and drink, and they backbite each other, and they swear at each
other. There are no places for them to learn the Holy Qur’an. Whomever does not listen to recitation of the
Holy Qur’an in their homes, their home is cursed! But now they follow the new fashion, dressing up on “New
Year’s Eve” to show off. How can the heavenly people support them, to increase their corruption? A`oodhu

billah!
Therefore, the matters of Egypt are not easy. In Egypt, Iraq, Sham, Yemen, Libya, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia,
the Turks, India, Iran and Sudan, this is the cause. Let their scholars observe our words. Their scholars are
arrogant and proud, thinking they are something and yet they have nothing to even support a fly! From
among those millions, if even one of them was sincere in his faith, he could lead his nation! Moses (a) pulled
behind him all the Children of Israel by himself! Allah (swt) opened the sea for them and they passed through
it! The others were people for this world and they were for the Hereafter.
May Allah (swt) forgive us and may He send mercy on us. Egypt runs after new fashions of the New Year,
saying, “We want money!” Seventy of Qaroon's treasures would not be enough for them! Allah (swt) knows
best our situation.
••••• •••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••• ••• •••••••••••
Wa maa khalaqtu‘l-jinna wa ’l-insa illa li-y`abudoo maa ureedoo minhum min rizqin wa maa ureedoo an
yut`imoon. I have only created jinn and men so that they may worship Me. No sustenance do I require of
them, nor do I require that they should feed Me. (Surat adh-Dhariyat, 51:56-57)
They should know this, not to run after this world. They must learn the truth of their creation and life on
Earth, “And I have not created jinn and men except that they should worship Me!” Tawbah yaa Rabbee,
tawbah yaa Rabbee!
There is at least one saint in Egypt whom, were his name mentioned, for his sake the whole world would
tremble! The world is not empty (of mercy, bounty), but you reap what you sow. That is the cause of their
problems: bad actions. They work for Shaytan and he rewards them with troubles. Madad yaa Sayyidin alSultan! Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. Allahuma ahdina fi man hadayt. Yaa Rabbee, yaa Allah!
Fatihah.
The worst of people are those who follow their egos and desires. People are following their whims, and each
one likes his individual opinion and greediness followed everywhere, so keep yourselves (beware) as this is it;
otherwise, this is their punishment. Prophets (a) came to guide people to their Lord, to turn their focus from

this world to their Lord, but those people are running after this world. There is no way out. There is not!
Astaghfirullah, tawbah yaa Rabbee! O Lord! Guide to the right way!
•••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••• ••••••• ••••••
Idh qaaloo li-nabiyyin lahum ab`ath lanaa malikan nuqaatil fee sabeelillah. Appoint to us a king so we may
fight in Allah's Way. (al-Baqarah 2:246)
Prophet (s) said first and foremost about our egos:
••••• •• •••••• •••••• ••• •••••• ••••••
raji`naa min al-jihaad al-asghar ila’l-jihaad al-akbar. "We came back from the smaller jihad to the greater
one."
They asked, "What is that, O Rasoolullah?" He said, "The battle of the ego." We returned from the smaller
jihad to the greater jihad. (al-Bayhaqi)
The smaller jihad is known to the Muslim world. There is no greater jihad, because everyone is following
their desires! Amaan yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. O our Lord! Correct
our steps and make our final destination a good one and send us someone to guide us! Allah, Allah. Amaan
yaa Rabbee.
Fatihah.
Lefke, 03.01.2012 (Translated from Arabic)
